CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_exp_tokens(member_id_input uuid, amount_input integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  update members set exp_tokens = coalesce(exp_tokens, 0) + amount_input where id = member_id_input;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_exp(member_id_input uuid, amount_input integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  update members set exp_tokens = coalesce(exp_tokens, 0) + amount_input
  where id = member_id_input;
$function$
